name: Vernal-Inselberg

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Nomad fleets riding the thermal belts, at war over every kilowatt of harvest.

description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an ancient meteor crater, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Roads and orbital mirrors betray minds at work, engineering on a civil scale.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
